homePageFAQs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
homePageFAQs.description: Clear answers to how Finvibes loan comparison, credit assessment, and partner sanction works.

items.q: Will checking loan offers on Finvibes impact my CIBIL credit score?
items.a: No. When you explore loan eligibility or compare bank offers on Finvibes, only a soft inquiry is conducted. Soft inquiries have 0% negative impact on your official CIBIL or credit score.

items.q: Does Finvibes charge any service or consultation fee from borrowers?
items.a: Finvibes is 100% free for consumers. We do not levy any platform, consultation, advisory, or hidden charges for comparing, checking eligibility, or applying for loan products.

items.q: How fast can I receive an in-principle loan sanction letter?
items.a: In-principle approvals are typically generated within 48 to 72 hours once your digital KYC and income documentation are submitted through our encrypted gateway.

items.q: Can I transfer my existing high-interest loan to a new lender?
items.a: Yes. Our Loan Balance Transfer desk helps you refinance existing home, personal, or business loans to partner banks offering lower interest rates, reducing your monthly EMI and overall interest burden.

items.q: What documents are required to initiate a digital loan application?
items.a: The standard digital KYC requires your PAN card, Aadhaar number (for paperless e-KYC), last 3–6 months' bank statements, and recent salary slips (for salaried) or ITR returns (for self-employed).

home-loan.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Home Loans
home-loan.description: Clear answers to interest rates, tax benefits, co-applicants, and home loan sanction processes.

items.q: What is the lowest home loan interest rate available on Finvibes?
items.a: Partner bank home loan rates currently start from 8.35% p.a. for borrowers with a CIBIL score of 750 or above. Actual interest rates depend on your credit profile, employment type, loan amount, and the partner lender selected.

items.q: Can I add a co-applicant to increase my home loan eligibility?
items.a: Yes. Adding an earning family member (spouse, parent, or working child) as a co-applicant pools your household income, significantly increasing your maximum sanctioned loan amount and eligibility.

items.q: What is the difference between fixed and floating home loan interest rates?
items.a: A floating rate fluctuates with the RBI Repo Linked Lending Rate (RLLR), allowing you to benefit from rate cuts without prepayment penalties. A fixed rate remains locked for a predetermined period, providing predictable EMIs regardless of market rate hikes.

items.q: Can I transfer my existing home loan to a new lender offering lower interest?
items.a: Yes. Through our Home Loan Balance Transfer facility, you can shift your outstanding loan balance to a partner bank offering a lower interest rate, reducing your monthly EMI and total interest outgo.

items.q: What tax benefits can I claim on my home loan repayments?
items.a: Borrowers can claim income tax deductions up to ₹1.5 Lakhs on principal repayment under Section 80C, and up to ₹2 Lakhs on interest payment under Section 24(b) of the Income Tax Act for a self-occupied property.

personal-loan.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Personal Loans
personal-loan.description: Everything you need to know about collateral-free personal loans, instant disbursal, and flexible tenure.

items.q: Is any collateral, guarantor, or security required for a personal loan?
items.a: No. Personal loans on Finvibes are 100% unsecured and collateral-free. Sanctions are based entirely on your monthly income, employment stability, and CIBIL credit score.

items.q: How fast is the loan amount credited to my bank account?
items.a: Once your digital e-KYC and income verification are completed online, partner banks typically disburse funds directly to your savings account in as little as 10 minutes to 24 hours.

items.q: Does checking my personal loan eligibility impact my credit score?
items.a: No. Checking eligibility or comparing partner bank quotes on Finvibes conducts only a soft credit check, which has zero negative impact on your official CIBIL credit score.

items.q: Can I prepay or foreclose my personal loan before the tenure ends?
items.a: Yes. Most partner banks allow part-prepayment or full foreclosure after a lock-in period of 6 to 12 monthly EMIs, allowing you to save substantial interest outgo.

items.q: What is the minimum monthly income required to apply for a personal loan?
items.a: The minimum net monthly salary required by premier partner banks typically starts from ₹20,000 for salaried employees and an annual gross turnover of ₹3 Lakhs for self-employed professionals.

business-loan.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Business Loans
business-loan.description: Essential information regarding unsecured business finance, working capital limits, and documentation.

items.q: What are the eligibility criteria for an unsecured business loan?
items.a: Your business should typically have an operational vintage of at least 1 to 2 years, an active GST registration, clean banking turnover, and a minimum annual revenue of ₹10 Lakhs.

items.q: What documents are required to apply for a digital business loan?
items.a: Key documents include business PAN card, Aadhaar card of the proprietor/directors, last 6 to 12 months' business bank statements, latest 2 years' ITR returns with computation of income, and GST returns.

items.q: Can startups or small MSMEs apply for collateral-free business loans?
items.a: Yes. We partner with specialized NBFCs and digital fintech lenders that extend unsecured working capital loans and machinery finance to small enterprises and emerging MSMEs based on cash-flow analysis.

items.q: How can funds from a business loan be utilized?
items.a: Business loan funds can be flexibly deployed for inventory purchase, working capital requirements, vendor payments, technology upgrades, plant expansion, or hiring talent.

car-loan.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Car Loans
car-loan.description: Understand new and used auto loan interest rates, on-road funding, and flexible repayment tenures.

items.q: Can I get 100% on-road financing for my new car purchase?
items.a: Yes. Several premier partner banks offer up to 90% to 100% on-road funding for selected new car models to qualified salaried and professional applicants with strong credit profiles.

items.q: What is the interest rate difference between new car and used car loans?
items.a: New car loan interest rates generally start lower (around 8.75% to 9.25% p.a.), while pre-owned car loans typically range between 11% to 14% p.a. due to vehicle depreciation and valuation factors.

items.q: What is the maximum repayment tenure available for car loans?
items.a: For brand new vehicles, partner banks provide flexible repayment terms up to 7 to 8 years (84–96 months). Used car loan tenures typically cap at 5 years depending on vehicle age.

items.q: Can self-employed professionals and business owners get a car loan?
items.a: Yes. Self-employed applicants can easily secure auto financing by providing business registration proof, the last 2 years' ITR with computation of income, and 6 months' primary current/savings account statements.

education-loan.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Education Loans
education-loan.description: Guidance on student loan interest rates, overseas funding, moratorium periods, and collateral guidelines.

items.q: Does an education loan cover living expenses, books, and airfare for studies abroad?
items.a: Yes. Comprehensive overseas student loans cover 100% of university tuition fees, campus accommodation, living food allowances, health insurance, textbooks, and international travel airfare.

items.q: Is collateral or security mandatory for overseas education loans?
items.a: Partner banks offer non-collateral (unsecured) education loans up to ₹40–50 Lakhs for premier universities in the US, UK, Canada, Germany, and Australia based on student GRE/GMAT scores and co-applicant income. Loans exceeding ₹50 Lakhs may require residential or commercial property as collateral.

items.q: What is a moratorium period and how does it work?
items.a: A moratorium period is a repayment holiday extending throughout the course duration plus an additional 6 to 12 months after graduation or getting a job. Regular principal and EMI repayments only commence after the moratorium ends.

items.q: Can I claim income tax deductions on education loan interest repayment?
items.a: Yes. Under Section 80E of the Income Tax Act, the entire interest paid on an education loan can be deducted from your taxable income with no upper limit for up to 8 consecutive assessment years.

credit-cards.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Credit Cards
credit-cards.description: Get clarity on lifetime-free cards, lounge access criteria, reward point redemption, and soft eligibility checks.

items.q: How can I obtain a lifetime-free (LTF) credit card with zero annual fees?
items.a: Several partner banks offer lifetime-free credit cards with ₹0 joining and ₹0 annual maintenance fees forever. Other cards provide annual fee waivers upon meeting annual milestone spends (e.g. spending ₹1 Lakh in a year).

items.q: Will checking pre-approved credit cards on Finvibes reduce my CIBIL score?
items.a: No. Exploring matched cards on Finvibes uses a soft-inquiry mechanism that never affects your CIBIL score. A hard credit inquiry is only placed when you formally submit an application with the card issuer.

items.q: How do complimentary airport lounge access privileges work?
items.a: Cards with travel perks offer between 2 to 8 complimentary domestic and international airport lounge entries per calendar quarter. Simply present your qualifying physical or virtual credit card at participating airport lounge entry desks.

items.q: What is fuel surcharge waiver and how is it applied?
items.a: Fuel surcharge waiver reimburses the standard 1% surcharge fee charged by petrol pumps across India for transactions typically between ₹400 and ₹5,000, saving substantial amounts for daily commuters.

items.q: How can I redeem accelerated reward points and cashback?
items.a: Cashback is directly credited to your card statement reducing your next bill, while reward points can be redeemed instantly for flight/hotel vouchers, gift cards from Amazon/Flipkart, or merchandise through your bank app.

savings-account.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Digital Accounts
savings-account.description: Everything you need to know about zero-balance digital accounts, interest rates, and paperless Video KYC.

items.q: Is there any minimum balance requirement or penalty for zero-balance digital accounts?
items.a: No. Zero-balance digital savings accounts require ₹0 minimum monthly average balance (MAB), with absolutely zero maintenance charges or non-maintenance penalty fees.

items.q: How does Video KYC onboarding work?
items.a: Video KYC is completed in under 5 minutes from your smartphone or laptop. An authorized bank officer connects on a brief encrypted video call to verify your original PAN card, Aadhaar biometric verification, and signature on blank paper.

items.q: What interest rate can I earn on my digital savings account balance?
items.a: Selected digital partner banks (such as Equitas, IDFC FIRST, and Kotak) offer attractive savings interest rates starting from 3.5% up to 7.5% p.a. calculated on your daily end-of-day balance.

items.q: When and how do I receive my debit card?
items.a: An instant virtual debit card is activated in your bank mobile app immediately upon Video KYC completion for online shopping and UPI. A personalized physical chip debit card is dispatched and delivered to your communication address within 5 to 7 working days.
